newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Aznar says risky to question EMU pact now.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Aznar says risky to question EMU pact now.

text.p: Spain's Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar said in Spanish newpaper interview published on Monday that it would be wrong to question the European Union's "stability pact" at this point in time.
"To question the Stability Pact at this time would introduce a very serious risk," Aznar told financial daily Expansion in an interview on Friday.
"It's a strict pact that is the result of very thorough and difficult negotiations that have demanded compromises and sacrifices on the part of everyone and should be respected."

Aznar, referring to a debate on the EU budget pact opened by France, said he understood there were legitimate reasons for some countries to want to introduce new factors, but he stood firm on the position that it should not happen.
"In no case should the basic body and essence of the Stability Pact be altered," he said.
